content.user_title: Install Markstream in Your Frontend App
content.value_statement: Adding a Markdown renderer can require package, peer dependency, CSS, and streaming decisions. This skill guides a minimal Markstream integration for the framework and rendering surface you use.
actual_capabilities: Identifies the matching Markstream package for Vue, Vue 2, React, Angular, or Svelte.
Selects only the optional peers needed for code, diagrams, math, or highlighting.
Explains CSS import order for reset styles, Markstream styles, Tailwind, and UnoCSS.
Recommends content or nodes inputs for static content, streaming, and custom AST workflows.
Configures Vue 3 renderer modes and virtual-scroll coordination for long chat interfaces.
Preserves safe HTML and strict Mermaid defaults during installation.
limitations: It does not install packages without an approved command execution step.
It does not replace framework-specific testing or production security review.
It only covers the Markstream packages and scenarios documented by this skill.
Trusted HTML or relaxed Mermaid settings still require application-specific risk review.

use_cases.title: Add a renderer to a Vue application
use_cases.description: Choose the Vue package, import CSS in the correct order, and add a small renderer for an existing page.

use_cases.title: Build a streaming chat surface
use_cases.description: Configure smooth streaming, chat mode, and history transitions without adding unnecessary peers.

use_cases.title: Integrate Markdown across a frontend team
use_cases.description: Document package selection, optional features, and validation steps for a React, Angular, or Svelte repository.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic installation
prompt_templates.prompt: Add Markstream to this Vue 3 application. Inspect the project first, choose the minimum dependencies, and explain each change.

prompt_templates.title: Enable math and diagrams
prompt_templates.prompt: Install Markstream for this React application with KaTeX math and Mermaid diagrams. Keep the default security settings and list the required CSS imports.

prompt_templates.title: Fix a streaming chat renderer
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Vue 3 chat renderer. Configure Markstream for streaming output and completed history while avoiding fade stacking.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a virtualized integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this Vue 3 repository with an existing message virtualizer. Propose a Markstream integration that keeps row ownership with the outer virtualizer.

output_examples.input: Add Markstream to a Vue 3 documentation page with highlighted code blocks.
output: Added only the code highlighting peer.
Placed reset styles before Markstream CSS.
Recommended docs mode for the page.

output_examples.input: Configure a React chat interface that receives streamed Markdown.
output: Recommended content input with automatic smooth streaming.
Kept streaming and recovered history settings distinct.
Advised validation with the smallest relevant build or test command.

best_practices: Inspect the host framework, CSS stack, and SSR requirements before choosing packages.
Install only the optional peers that match requested features.
Keep safe HTML and strict Mermaid defaults unless a trusted, scoped exception is required.
anti_patterns: Do not install every optional peer dependency by default.
Do not depend on renderer imports to inject package CSS.
Do not relax HTML or Mermaid policies across the entire application for legacy compatibility.

faq.question: Which Markstream package should I install?
faq.answer: Choose the package that matches the host framework: Vue 3, Vue 2, React, Angular, or Svelte 5.

faq.question: Should I install all optional peers?
faq.answer: No. Add peers only for features such as Monaco, Mermaid, D2, KaTeX, or lightweight highlighting.

faq.question: Where should Markstream CSS be imported?
faq.answer: Import reset styles first, then Markstream CSS. Use the components layer in Tailwind or UnoCSS projects.

faq.question: When should I use content instead of nodes?
faq.answer: Use content for static pages and most streaming chat. Use nodes when another layer owns parsing or AST transforms.

faq.question: How should Vue 3 chat mode be configured?
faq.answer: Use chat mode for AI chat or SSE output, then adjust smooth streaming and fade settings for streaming or recovered history.

faq.question: Can I enable trusted HTML or relaxed Mermaid settings?
faq.answer: Only for a trusted, scoped surface with a clear compatibility need. Do not change the application-wide defaults blindly.
